notes: SBLGNT.LUK.21.11.v013 is underdetermined among three readings with r00-base carried; every token of the base is realized in the ASV, so no rule 97 surplus arises.
The ASV writes two English conjunctions for each τε … καί pair, so under rule 70 each particle keeps its own and neither is unrepresented.
λιμοί takes famines and λοιμοί takes pestilences; the packet's interlinear glosses reverse the two lexemes, and the ASV keeps the Greek order.
κατά takes in divers, the distributive sense being the preposition's; reading divers as a helper on τόπους remains defensible and is named in that unit's note.
